test_title: PYST 70: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 27 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: Volunteering is linked to better mental and physical welbeing.
Volunteering is linked to beter mental and physical wellbeing.
Voluntering is linked to better mental and physical wellbeing.
Volunteering is linked to better mental and physical wellbeing.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"volunteering"** means offering to do something out of one's own free will, typically without payment. (स्वेच्छा से काम करना)

 
 
• **Example:** **Volunteering **at the local shelter has been a rewarding experience.
 
 
 
• **"wellbeing"** refers to the state of being comfortable, healthy, or happy. (कल्याण)
 
 
• **Example:** Regular exercise is essential for maintaining physical and mental **wellbeing.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** "welbeing" should be "wellbeing". (कल्याण)

 
 
• **Example:** Mental and physical wellbeing are interconnected.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "beter" should be "better". (बेहतर)
 
 
• **Example:** A better understanding of the subject can improve your grades.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "Voluntering" should be "Volunteering". (स्वेच्छा से काम करना)
 
 
• **Example:** Volunteering for community service helps build character.
